description: The brand finishing pack — action 'all' (default) chains everything in ONE call: logo (typography specialist, perfect spelling — skipped if one already exists) → favicon/app-icon pack (favicon.ico 16/32/48, apple-touch-icon, 192/512 PNG, site.webmanifest + HTML tags) → og:image 1200×630 with the title written ON the image. Or one piece at a time: action 'logo' | 'favicons' | 'social_image'. To SHOW the logo in the page (not just generate the file), pass page_path with a logo placeholder in the header () — the generated logo is wired straight into it, so it never ends up generated-but-unused.

background.description: favicons: solid background colour behind the icon (any CSS colour, e.g. '#ffffff' or 'oklch(...)'). Default white. A solid background is required — a transparent icon disappears on a dark tab and turns black on the iOS home screen.

logo_placeholder.description: logo: optional fragment of the target logo placeholder's src/tag, to pick WHICH placeholder gets the logo (default: the one that looks like a logo/brand slot).

page_path.description: logo: the page to wire the logo into (it replaces a header logo placeholder — an whose alt/src says 'logo', or the one named by logo_placeholder). Without it, the logo file is still created but not placed in the page.

public_prefix.description: logo: URL prefix used in the patched (default '/'). Use a relative prefix for a plain static page where public/ is NOT the web root.

source_path.description: favicons: optional existing logo/icon to derive from — a file path, or "clipboard" to use a copied image

tagline.description: logo: optional small tagline under the name

title.description: social_image: title written on the image (default: brand name)

name: brand_pack
title: Logo, favicon pack, social image
